messages.message:
Yes, you can return the beakers if they are unused and still in their unopened original packaging. Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for a full refund of the goods, but you would need to pay the return postage unless the items were faulty or sent in error.

To start a return, please email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and the reason. You will receive a returns number and label within one working day.

Would you like to check the delivery date to be sure you are within the 30-day window?
